name: The Cold Forge
desc:
The Cold Forge is a laboratory hidden within [Scyphozia](location:the_depths), inside of a frozen cavern known as the [Brinepool Passage](location:brinepool_passage). It is linked to the Dormant Splinter.

A Laboratory used by Coldheart Fortinbras. This location seems to be a somewhat small laboratory partially covered in ice due to the freezing temperature, housing an assortment of bookshelves, pipes and glass tubes. In the center of the room is a pit full of a black, foggy unknown substance. This room also has lights similar to what can be found in [Castle Light](location:castle_light), but instead of glowing yellow, these glow blue. Two sets of lockers can be found at the entrance.

A lore book called "Coldheart's Journal" when equipped, can be found in one of the corners on a table that may contain possible lore about the near future attunement; Lifeweave.
